articles.title: Alexander Zverev beats Ben Shelton to win the US Open title and extend a drought by American men - apnews.com
articles.description: Alexander Zverev won his second major championship and kept American men without a Grand Slam title since 2003, beating Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 on Sunday in the U.S. Open final. Zverev finally broke through in the majors by winning this year’s Fren…
